verses.en: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.
verses.pt: Ainda que eu esteja disposto a curar Israel, expostas estão a perversidade de Efraim e as maldades de Samaria, porque praticam a falsidade; o ladrão vem, e o bando de assaltantes despoja do lado de fora.
verses.en_web: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.
verses.en_bbe: When my desire was for the fate of my people to be changed and to make Israel well, then the sin of Ephraim was made clear, and the evil-doing of Samaria; for their ways are false, and the thief comes into the house, while the band of outlaws takes property by force in the streets.

verses.en: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
verses.pt: E nem percebem em seus corações eu me lembro de toda a maldade deles; agora seus atos os cercam; diante de mim estão.
verses.en_web: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.
verses.en_bbe: And they do not say to themselves that I keep in mind all their sin; now their evil acts come round them on every side; they are before my face.

verses.en: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.pt: Com sua maldade alegram ao rei, e com suas mentiras aos príncipes.
verses.en_web: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.en_bbe: In their sin they make a king for themselves, and rulers in their deceit.

verses.en: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
verses.pt: Todos eles cometem adultério; semelhantes são ao forno aceso pelo padeiro, que deixa de atiçar depois da massa estar feita, até que esteja levedada.
verses.en_web: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.
verses.en_bbe: They are all untrue; they are like a burning oven; the bread-maker does not make up the fire from the time when the paste is mixed till it is leavened.

verses.en: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
verses.pt: No dia do nosso rei, os príncipes ficam doentes pelo calor do vinho; ele estende sua mão com os zombadores.
verses.en_web: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.
verses.en_bbe: On the day of our king, the rulers made him ill with the heat of wine; his hand was stretched out with the men of pride.

verses.en: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
verses.pt: Porque preparam seus corações para suas ciladas como a um forno; toda a noite seu padeiro dorme, pela manhã arde como fogo flamejante.
verses.en_web: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their baker sleeps all the night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.
verses.en_bbe: For they have made their hearts ready like an oven, while they are waiting secretly; their wrath is sleeping all night; in the morning it is burning like a flaming fire.

verses.en: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.
verses.pt: Todos eles se aquecem como um forno, e devoraram os seus juízes; todos os seus reis caem; ninguém há entre eles que clame a mim.
verses.en_web: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.
verses.en_bbe: They are all heated like an oven, and they put an end to their judges; all their kings have been made low; not one among them makes prayer to me.

verses.en: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
verses.pt: Efraim se mistura com os povos; Efraim é um bolo que não foi virado.
verses.en_web: Ephraim, he mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.
verses.en_bbe: Ephraim is mixed with the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not turned.

verses.en: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
verses.pt: Estrangeiros devoram sua riqueza, sem que ele perceba; e até o cabelo grisalho se espalha por ele, e ele não percebeu.
verses.en_web: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.
verses.en_bbe: Men from other lands have made waste his strength, and he is not conscious of it; grey hairs have come on him here and there, and he has no knowledge of it.

verses.en: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.
verses.pt: A soberba de Israel dá testemunho contra ele, porém não se convertem ao SENHOR seu Deus, nem o buscam, apesar de tudo isto.
verses.en_web: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to Yahweh their God, nor sought him, for all this.
verses.en_bbe: And the pride of Israel gives an answer to his face; but for all this, they have not gone back to the Lord their God, or made search for him.

verses.en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.pt: E foi Efraim como pomba imprudente, sem inteligência; chamam ao Egito, vão à Assíria.
verses.en_web: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.
verses.en_bbe: And Ephraim is like a foolish dove, without wisdom; they send out their cry to Egypt, they go to Assyria.

verses.en: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
verses.pt: Quando forem, estenderei minha rede sobre eles; eu os farei cair como as aves do céu. Eu os castigarei conforme o que se tem ouvido quando eles se reúnem.
verses.en_web: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
verses.en_bbe: When they go, my net will be stretched out over them; I will take them like the birds of heaven, I will give them punishment, I will take them away in the net for their sin.

verses.en: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
verses.pt: Ai deles, porque se afastaram de mim; destruição sobre eles, porque se rebelaram contra mim; eu os livraria, porém falam mentiras contra mim.
verses.en_web: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
verses.en_bbe: May trouble be theirs! for they have gone far away from me; and destruction, for they have been sinning against me; I was ready to be their saviour, but they said false words against me.

verses.en: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
verses.pt: E não clamam a mim com seus corações quando gemem sobre suas camas; eles se reúnem para o trigo e o vinho, porém de mim se afastam.
verses.en_web: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.
verses.en_bbe: And they have not made prayer to me in their hearts, but they make loud cries on their beds; they are cutting themselves for food and wine, they are turned against me.

verses.en: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
verses.pt: Eu os treinei, e fortalecei seus braços, porém pensam o mal contra mim.
verses.en_web: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.
verses.en_bbe: Though I have given training and strength to their arms, they have evil designs against me.

verses.en: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Eles se voltam, mas não para o Altíssimo. Eles são como um arco defeituoso; seus príncipes caem à espada por causa da insolência de suas línguas; por isso serão escarnecidos na terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: They have gone to what is of no value; they are like a false bow; their captains will come to destruction by the sword, and their ruler by my wrath; for this, the land of Egypt will make sport of them.
